(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix alerts-scheduler (alert suppression rules). For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/alerting/alert-suppression-rules/."
description  StringAttribute optional computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to 
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler description."
enabled  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler enabled. If set to `false`, the alert scheduler will be disabled. True by default."
filter  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler filter. Only one of `meta_labels` or `alerts_unique_ids` can be set. If none of them set, all alerts will be affected."
filter.alerts_unique_ids  SetAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Alert unique ids."
    validator: schemavalidator.ConflictsWithValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, these are not set: "[<.meta_labels]"
filter.meta_labels  SetNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Meta labels."
    validator: schemavalidator.ConflictsWithValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, these are not set: "[<.alerts_unique_ids]"
filter.meta_labels[]  NestedObject
filter.meta_labels[].key  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The key."
filter.meta_labels[].value  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The value."
filter.what_expression  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "A [DataPrime](https://coralogix.com/docs/dataprime-query-language/) expression that filters which **group-by values** to suppress within the selected alerts. The expression must start with `source logs | filter` (this syntax is required even for metric or tracing alerts - the filtering works on group-by values regardless of alert type). Use `\"source logs | filter true\"` to suppress all alert activity without filtering specific values. Use `\"source logs | filter $d.fieldName == 'value'\"` to suppress only when specific group-by values match. This field controls **what triggered values** to suppress, while `alerts_unique_ids` or `meta_labels` control **which alerts** the rule applies to."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
meta_labels  SetNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler meta labels."
meta_labels[]  NestedObject
meta_labels[].key  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The key."
meta_labels[].value  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The value."
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Alert Scheduler name."
schedule  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Exactly one of `one_time` or `recurring` must be set."
schedule.one_time  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "One time."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.recurring]"
schedule.one_time.time_frame  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Timeframe."
schedule.one_time.time_frame.duration  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "The duration from the start time to wait."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.end_time]"
schedule.one_time.time_frame.duration.for_over  Int64Attribute required
    markdown: "The number of time units to wait before the alert is triggered. For example, if the frequency is set to `hours` and the value is set to `2`, the alert will be triggered after 2 hours."
schedule.one_time.time_frame.duration.frequency  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The time unit to wait before the alert is triggered. Can be `minutes`, `hours` or `days`."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["days" "hours" "minutes"]
schedule.one_time.time_frame.end_time  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The end time of the time frame. In a isodate format. For example, `2021-01-01T00:00:00.000`."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.duration]"
schedule.one_time.time_frame.start_time  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Start time in ISO8601 format (e.g. `2026-02-17T08:00:00.000` or `2026-02-17T08:00:00.000Z`)."
schedule.one_time.time_frame.time_zone  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Timezone (e.g. `UTC`, `UTC+0`, `UTC+2`). Both `UTC` and `UTC+0` are accepted for zero offset."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["UTC" "UTC+0" "UTC+1" "UTC+10" "UTC+11" "UTC+12" "UTC+13" "UTC+14" "UTC+2" "UTC+3" "UTC+4" "UTC+5" "UTC+6" "UTC+7" "UTC+8" "UTC+9" "UTC-1" "UTC-10" "UTC-11" "UTC-2" "UTC-3" "UTC-4" "UTC-5" "UTC-6" "UTC-7" "UTC-8" "UTC-9"]
schedule.operation  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The operation to perform. Can be `mute` or `active`."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["active" "mute" "unspecified"]
schedule.recurring  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Recurring schedule configuration. Use `dynamic` for time-based recurring schedules, or `always_active = true` for permanent suppression rules."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.one_time]"
schedule.recurring.always_active  BoolAttribute optional
    markdown: "When set to `true`, creates a permanent suppression rule that is always active. This is mutually exclusive with `dynamic`. When using `always_active = true`, no time frame or frequency configuration is needed."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.dynamic]"
